resources.string: Manually sends ordinary GET / requests to saved, verified local IPv4/IPv6 listeners, over HTTP and strict HTTPS. These requests may count in Web logs and statistics. No address is created.

A content prefix is not a complete image or proof of browser rendering. This check is independent of the fresh listener receipt above; HTTPS verifies the actual IP, not localhost. QUIC/HTTP3 is not tested.
